FrontierCO: Benchmark Dataset for Frontier Combinatorial Optimization
	

Paper: CO-Bench: Benchmarking Language Model Agents in Algorithm Search for Combinatorial Optimization | Code: CO-Bench GitHub Repository

	
		
		Overview
	

FrontierCO is a curated benchmark suite for evaluating ML-based solvers on large-scale and real-world Combinatorial Optimization (CO) problems. The benchmark spans 8 classical CO problems across 5 application domains, providing both training and evaluation… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/CO-Bench/FrontierCO.
reputation: An emerging benchmark suite used in recent ML-for-CO research with growing adoption among researchers working on learned solvers and algorithm search.
